pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with predominantly smooth to moderately defined edge gradients. Patch spatial area is larger on the mid-flank and transitions to smaller, more densely packed geometries towards the dorsal ridge and lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space with frequent 3-way and 4-way junction nodes. Corridor thickness is variable, exhibiting wider pixel-width on the mid-flank and narrowing as it approaches the cervical and dorsal regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, brush-like mane exhibiting a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette. The contour is composed of fine, vertical dark-amber pixel clusters against the background.
